title: Internet Scams & Fake News
description: Learn how to identify fake messages, phishing scams, and how to verify information before sharing it.

scenes.text: You receive a WhatsApp message from an unknown number: 'Congratulations! You have won an iPhone 15! Click this link to claim your prize before it expires!'
The message says the link will expire in 10 minutes. What should you do?

choices.text: Click it quickly! I want a new phone.
choices.feedbackText: Wait! This is a classic 'Phishing Scam'. Scammers create a false sense of urgency to make you act without thinking. Never click links from unknown numbers.

choices.text: Ignore it, block the number, and do not click the link.
choices.feedbackText: Excellent! If something sounds too good to be true, it probably is. This is a phishing scam meant to steal your personal data.

scenes.text: Let's sort out how to handle different types of online information. Drag them to the correct action.

dragItems.text: A forward message claiming an apocalypse is coming tomorrow
An email asking for your password to 'secure your account'
A friend's post about their birthday party

choices.feedbackText: Great job! Always verify scary forwards (Fake News), never share passwords (Scams), and it's fine to interact with real friends.
Try again! Remember, no real company will ever ask for your password via email.

scenes.text: You successfully avoided the scam and stopped the spread of fake news! Your digital identity remains secure.
